newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia says 1996 GDP growth at 8.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia says 1996 GDP growth at 8.2 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's gross domestic product (GDP) grew by 8.2 percent in 1996 against 9.5 percent in 1995, Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim said on Saturday.
The 1996 current account deficit was at 11.0 billion ringgit, lower than the 18.7 billion shortfall in 1995, he said when releasing key economic data after a meeting of the National Finance Council.
